question_text: Read the passage carefully and complete the table below
stimulus: with information from the passage. 1×5=5 At present, globalization is often heard term all over the world. The world has now become a global village because of globalization. Globalization and capitalism are interrelated. Capitalists use the advantages of globalisation. Globalisation is creating more opportunities for Capitalist countries. Then the developing countries, taking the advantages of globalization. Capitalist is marching rapidly. Even capitalists are exploiting the poor taking the merits of globalization. It is said that globalization is creating job opportunities for the poor. Indeed, the reality is opposite to it. It is an eye wash, nothing else. globalization helps build up same vessel but in different cabins. So globalizations contries are being benefited. On the contrary, the poor countries are becoming poorer. Because of globalisation the gap between the rich and the poor are widening. Under the influence of globalisation, global cultures are getting mixed with our own culture. As a result, we are losing are our own culture. To make our world a better living place, globalisation can play a vital role. Main focus What cause Demerits Globalization technological to create (i) ..........
